answer: Orchard Bloom Delay: each agent identity must complete a distinct sequence of timed growth tasks (planting jade seedlings, pruning, harvesting saffron plots) whose schedule is randomly assigned per identity at registration. Duplicates fail because two agents claiming the same identity produce overlapping task timestamps, revealing the copy. An attacker pays full task compute plus wall-clock delay per fake identity, and any clone is exposed the moment schedules collide.
